title: Disclosing fund restrictions on county land
summary: On July 28, a motion to recommend passing Bill 81 (2025) on first reading carried with nine ayes. The bill would require the County to disclose fund restrictions when it budgets money to develop County-owned land. The administration had no objection to providing the extra information.
